people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.
translations.bsb: On their arrival in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders, to whom they reported all that God had done through them.
translations.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
translations.asv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church and the apostles and the elders, and they rehearsed all things that God had done with them.
